objective: Single Android Wall photo flow with immediate cached sharp originals, independent preview->original promotion, and no conflicting 30-second duplicate download
productionBaselineEvidence: Main SHA 72de1e7f16b9ccf704147c14cbd61c35d2dd94b2 merged PR #443. Verified historical Android Production OTA 01a18bdb-50ee-7c4f-928e-b16925cb8c14 (runtime 1.3.2, source 646617b5); newer client telemetry shows 01a18c39-4ca5-7d03-ba11-1dea511852c5 but exact source and device rendering not yet verified. Prior Supabase inspection: 814 indexed previews, 209 failed preview-generation jobs, all 209 originals exist. Physical device skipped by owner previously.
chosenApproach: Android Wall preview stays first-paint hint; independently attempt authenticated original immediately even while preview pending, reuse stable-key disk original before queueing new original network download, limit new original downloads to 2 via existing gate, promote only after matching decoded+display events, keep bounded native renderer fallback, remove redundant unconditional 30-second switch to original.
alternativeApproaches: Download originals for every Wall photo and abandon lightweight previews (rejected: weak-network delay, data costs, memory risk)
Wait until preview native onLoad fires before starting sharp original (rejected: white tile/stalled preview blocks sharp original)
Maintain separate 30-second automatic switch to direct original while original upgrade is already downloading (rejected: duplicate requests and flicker)
Change all platforms including generic web/iOS/Connect implementation (rejected: not the Android root cause and introduces unrelated regressions)
selectionRationale: Unifies priority and fallback at the Android Wall boundary while preserving full-screen and other platforms; data stays private and cache keys remain media-path based.
preserveBehaviors: No changes to public/scoped Wall data pipeline, content permissions, private signed URL generation, RLS or Storage
No new native module or build; Android production runtime 1.3.2 retained
No changes to generic web/iOS photo pipeline or Connect and fullscreen zoom viewer
Existing preview files, original Storage objects, uploader and thumbnail indexing retained
Existing bounded retry and fallback do not restart progressing weak-network streams
Community card layout, taps, zoom and ad placement untouched
acceptanceChecks: An indexed sidecar in loading/white/pending state never gates original upgrade
An already disk-cached full original skips network slot and Storage signing, online or offline
A new original consumes one bounded network slot; release on display/failure/unmount
No unconditional timeout triggers duplicate original download alongside upgrade
Preview remains mounted/visible until decoded/displayed original can replace it
Unindexed photos use the original directly; missing previews fall back to secured original
Pass behavior tests, TypeScript, existing sidecar and weak-network regressions and release gates; RC/production requires exact OTA evidence
